title: Layer 1: Core Intent IR
description: Strict semantic representation of human intent, devoid of assumed technical solutions.

primary_problem.description: The exact pain point or intent observed (e.g., 'orphaned_transaction', 'performance_degradation').

secondary_problem.description: Any additional pain point observed in the same input.

evidence.description: The raw tokens/words that triggered this mapping.

requires_diagnosis.description: True if the system cannot pinpoint the root technical cause (e.g., 'slow' does not strictly mean 'memory_leak').

requires_clarification.description: True if multiple interpretations exist and the Clarification Engine must be triggered.

confidence_score.description: Calculated dynamically based on matched signals, negation stability, conflict count, and clarification success.
